status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Pocket Box Ltd (Company number NI665589) is an active private limited company incorporated on 6 November 2019.

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based software provides vehicle tracking, fuel management, and driver behavior monitoring (including speeding, harsh braking, and idling) within a unified dashboard, integrated with hardware partners Inseego and Lytx.
According to an operational case study reported by the company, client Connected Health achieved a 29% reduction in overall fleet spend after deploying the Pocket Box platform.
Pocket Box Ltd maintains an active status as a data controller under registration reference ZB520983 with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), valid until March 5, 2027.

The company reports that its cloud-based platform is designed with a modular architecture that scales from small fleets of 5 vehicles to enterprise operations of 500 or more vehicles, currently serving over 200 small and medium-sized enterprise clients across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
claims.note: The details regarding the modular architecture scaling specifically from 5 to 500 or more vehicles are unconfirmed in the provided sources.

claims.claim: The company reports that its system integrates with various third-party technologies, featuring an automated fuel card transaction import module, a DVLA license check API, and direct tracking and camera integrations through partnerships with Inseego and Lytx.
claims.note: The specific automated fuel card transaction import module and DVLA license check API details are unconfirmed in the provided sources.

claims.claim: AMC Construction Ltd partnered with Pocket Box Ltd to deploy its fleet management, integrated telematics, and Fleet Vehicle Check App across a remote fleet and more than 100 construction workers in England, Scotland, and Ireland.
claims.source: AMC Construction website ("AMC Construction partner with Pocket Box Fleet Management")

claims.claim: Pocket Box Ltd secured a funded project value of £90,026 through an Innovate UK grant from November 2020 to April 2021 to support the development of its vehicle management and digital marketing application, projecting a year-5 post-project revenue target of £12 million.

According to a company announcement reported by Fleet News, Pocket Box Ltd officially launched its SME-focused commercial fleet management and compliance software solution in October 2022, scaling its active client operations to serve over 200 businesses across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
claims.note: The detail regarding scaling active client operations to serve over 200 businesses across the United Kingdom and Ireland could not be verified in official announcements or coverage.

claims.claim: An integrated telematics partnership announced in January 2023 between vehicle and driver management software specialist Pocket Box and Inseego UK enables commercial fleet operators to access combined live tracking and compliance management.
claims.source: Fleet News ("Inseego and Pocket Box partnership offers integrated fleet technology", January 2023)

claims.claim: A formal partnership launched in June 2026 with driver risk management specialist Safe2Drive Solutions integrates automated UK DVLA driving licence checks directly into the Pocket Box platform.
claims.source: Fleet World ("Safe2Drive Solutions and Pocket Box Fleet Management partner to boost fleet compliance", June 2026)

claims.claim: The company reports that over 200 small and medium-sized businesses use its cloud-based platform daily to manage company vehicles across the UK and Ireland, according to the official Pocket Box YouTube Channel.
claims.corrected: The company reports that over 200 small and medium-sized businesses use its cloud-based platform daily to manage company vehicles across the UK and Ireland, according to the official Pocket Box website.

claims.claim: Pocket Box Ltd maintains a head office located at 13a Margaret Street, Newry, County Down, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom, and lists an employee base of between 2 and 10 individuals on its corporate registration platforms.
